title: Add a pre-commit hook and a typecheck script
notes:
From the 30-session retro (2026-11-16):
- package.json has `lint` and `test` but no `typecheck`, so `tsc --noEmit` runs only in CI.
- There is no pre-commit hook. Worker 2c34293e hit an eslint error mid-edit ("'wholePath' is defined but never used").
- Windows-only test failures (Unix paths in tests) reached #288 and #289 after the review loop had finished; only CI's windows-latest job caught them.

Want:
- `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"`;
- a pre-commit hook running lint and typecheck on staged files;
- a review-checklist line: tests touching paths or processes use path.join or skip on win32, like the neighbouring files.
